resources.string: This build cannot compile or package anything yet. No plugin can produce an artifact, so there is no Build button and there will not be one until there is something behind it. What does exist is listed below: every subsystem states its own maturity and exactly what it still lacks, and none of them has reached PRODUCTION.

This builds a real APK on this device with nothing but Omni: the manifest is written as binary XML, packaged into a ZIP, signed with an RSA key generated here, under a certificate written here. Every project is checked against the security policy first, and a project that fails it produces no package.
The package carries a manifest only. There is no compiler and no DEX writer yet, so it holds no code — that is phases 9 and 10.
%1$d of %2$d phases delivered. A delivered phase means its work landed, not that it is finished: what state that work is in is what the subsystems below say.
%1$d of %2$d Core subsystems have passed every quality gate. The rest state below exactly what they still lack.
%1$d of %2$d pinned components could be verified on this device. The rest run on a build host and are reported as unverifiable rather than assumed.
%1$d of %2$d declared plugins are implemented. The others exist as contracts only.

Every run rewrites these files. The copy in the application\'s own storage always succeeds and is what the crash handler relies on. The copy under Android/data/com.omni.builder/files/%1$s needs no permission and any file manager reaches it. The copy under Documents/%1$s is the easiest to find when the device allows it. Whichever of them failed says so above, with the reason.
